name: Instrument Library Search Taxonomy
purpose: A framework for ordering and searching instrument categories, individual instruments, patches, presets, samples, loops, and sound-design assets.
search_design_notes: Use category_instrument_order for UI ordering within each Tier 1 category.
Use instruments[].secondary_category_ids when an instrument should appear in multiple browse categories.

Do not create new Tier 2 instruments for subjective variants like soft violin or rough violin. Store those as Tier 3 metadata in timbre, articulation, mood, technique, dynamic, recording, or production_style.
Aliases intentionally include common misspellings or informal names where useful for search, such as otanote for Otamatone.
Sort orders use gaps of 10 so new categories or instruments can be inserted later without renumbering everything.

categories.name: Strings
categories.description: Bowed and plucked orchestral or folk strings.

categories.name: Woodwinds
categories.description: Flutes, reeds, free reeds, pipes, and saxophones.

categories.name: Percussion
categories.description: Pitched and unpitched percussion, including kits and hand percussion.

categories.name: Keyboards
categories.description: Acoustic, electric, and mechanical keyboard instruments.

categories.name: Synth / Electronic
categories.description: Synthesizers, electronic instruments, experimental devices, and electronic sound sources.

categories.name: Guitars & Fretted
categories.description: Guitars, fretted plucked instruments, and related chordophones.

categories.name: Bass
categories.description: Dedicated bass instruments and low-end sound sources.

categories.name: Voice
categories.description: Solo voice, spoken voice, vocal effects, and vocal performance types.

categories.name: World / Traditional
categories.description: Regional, folk, and traditional instruments from many performance traditions.

categories.name: Folk / Acoustic
categories.description: Folk-centered acoustic instruments and common singer-songwriter or roots instruments.

categories.name: Historical / Early Music
categories.description: Medieval, Renaissance, Baroque, and period instruments.

categories.name: Toy / Novelty Instruments
categories.description: Toy, novelty, comic, educational, and meme-friendly instruments.

categories.name: Sound Design / Foley
categories.description: Designed sound, field recordings, object sounds, transitions, and effects.

categories.name: Drum Machines & Grooveboxes
categories.description: Electronic drum sources, classic drum machine styles, and groovebox-style devices.

categories.name: Samplers
categories.description: Sample playback, phrase sampling, sliced loops, and granular sample instruments.

categories.name: Ensembles / Sections
categories.description: Groups of instruments ordered by practical scoring or production role.

categories.name: Hybrid / Processed
categories.description: Layered, resampled, processed, and acoustic-electronic hybrid instruments.

pitched_melodic.description: General template for pitched melodic instruments.

world_traditional.description: Use region and tradition as metadata rather than hard-coding culture into only one category.

folk_acoustic.description: For roots, folk, singer-songwriter, and acoustic performance contexts.
